query: Initialize `.engr/` for this long-running effort so agents can preserve facts, unknowns, decisions, risks, and verification without rewriting one giant backlog document.
Resume WI-20260807-03 from our engineering EventStore, replay anything after the current State head, and show me only the active problem and verification gates.
Two worktrees selected different solutions from the same parent event in `.engr/eventstore/`. Reconcile the stream without last-write-wins.
Regenerate BACKLOG.md and DECISIONS.md from the replayed engineering State; those Markdown files have drifted and must not be treated as truth.
Record the owner's accepted residual security risk in WI-20260808-04, but make sure the exact wording is confirmed before it becomes durable.
Our long-running coding agent keeps resurrecting rejected options and dropping old constraints after 40 turns. Adopt an append-only semantic engineering record with deterministic replay.
The implementation finished but topology changed after V2 passed. Invalidate stale verification, reopen the work item, and keep the old evidence traceable.
The approved Engr binary is unavailable on this workstation. Install the compatible Engr release and verify protocol-v1 conformance instead of rebuilding or replacing it.
Create a Decision Record stream for the key-distribution trust boundary, preserve the exact approved wording, and later supersede it without rewriting history.
Design EventStoreDB streams and projections for our ecommerce order service. We need optimistic concurrency and subscription recommendations.
Our Elasticsearch cluster is red after a rolling restart. Diagnose shard allocation and recover the ES data nodes.
Write an ADR explaining why this small service uses Postgres instead of MySQL; the repository has no `.engr/` protocol and we are not adopting one.
Append what I worked on today to my personal daily journal and generate a manager update in Traditional Chinese.
Save a private checkpoint so another agent can resume this chat tomorrow with the current focus and pending evidence.
Add structured audit logging for every login attempt and send the logs to our SIEM.
Model Kafka business events for order fulfillment and choose partition keys for consumers.
Fix this one failing unit test, run the focused suite, and stop. There is no durable multi-turn record system in the project.
Summarize the Git history of this feature branch into release notes. Do not change project files.
